records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Maple Group!
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks for setting up Maple Group on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invites, no key milestone, and zero customer replies to the welcome email [email:373b02f9]. The customer no-showed the getting-started call [calendar:489837f5], signalling low engagement. No tickets either way. Team plan suggests intent, so not negligible, but 8 days unaided looks unlikely.

draft.subject: Picking up where we left off, Maple Group
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Sorry we missed each other on Thursday — I know launch weeks get full. Nothing is lost on your side: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, or bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to work through that first project with you live and answer anything about setup for your team.

Best,
Priya

decisions.rationale: Customer replied unprompted with momentum: first project reached 2026-09-27 and Marisol adding team this week [email:625eec63]; 1 invite already sent, 8 days left, no tickets. Offset by a no-show onboarding call [calendar:489837f5] and activity driven by a non-admin.

draft.subject: Re: Welcome to Wrenfield, Maple Group!
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks for the update — great to hear Marisol got your first project set up this morning, and that the rest of the team is coming on this week.

One thing that may save her time: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and you can do that from Account Settings -> Members at any time. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so once people are in, that's where the work lands.

Happy to jump on a short call this week to help get the team set up — just say the word and I'll find a time.

Best,
Priya
